BunkerWeb | Next-generation, open-source Web Application Firewall (WAF)

summary.one_liner: BunkerWeb is an open-source, NGINX-based Web Application Firewall and reverse proxy that protects web services with secure-by-default settings.
summary.what_it_does: BunkerWeb runs as a reverse proxy in front of web applications and is built on NGINX. It includes HTTPS with Let's Encrypt automation, HTTP security headers, TLS hardening, and an integrated ModSecurity WAF with the OWASP Core Rule Set. It can automatically ban clients based on HTTP status codes, apply connection and request limits, and challenge bots with cookie, JavaScript, captcha, hCaptcha, or reCAPTCHA checks. It also blocks known bad IPs using external blacklists and DNSBL. Configuration is done through settings (environment-style variables) stored in a database (SQLite, MariaDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL) by a scheduler service, with an optional web UI and a plugin system.
use_cases: protect web applications with a WAF
reverse proxy in front of web services
automatic HTTPS certificates with Let's Encrypt
block bots with captchas or JavaScript challenges
serve multiple sites from one instance (multisite)
manage WAF settings through a web interface
how_to_run: Choose an integration: Linux packages, Docker, Docker autoconf, Swarm, Kubernetes (Helm chart), or Microsoft Azure
Follow the Quickstart guide in the BunkerWeb documentation
Configure settings such as SERVER_NAME and AUTO_LETS_ENCRYPT for your application
notable: Secure-by-default configuration with many security features enabled out of the box
Integrations for Linux, Docker, Docker autoconf, Swarm, Kubernetes, and Azure
Optional web UI for managing instances, settings, custom configs, and viewing blocked attacks
Plugin system with official plugins such as ClamAV, Coraza, VirusTotal, and webhook notifications
Multisite mode to protect several applications from one instance
caveats: Some features are only in the PRO version (marked with a crown in docs); a 30-day trial is offered and PRO requires a license key
Managed BunkerWeb Cloud and professional support are paid offerings from the maintainers
README says community support is via Discord, forums, and GitHub discussions, not GitHub issues
